data.description:
# Emit compaction metadata response headers

Implementation half of **LP-0MTYGZ1DI0004QP8**. Surfaces the compaction
decision already produced by `plan_session_compaction` on the HTTP response
so the Pi client can mirror the proxy's compacted view. No client changes
here -- the consumer is SA-0MTYGZIWF000ZLU0.

## Design

1. `proxy/router_helpers.py` `_handle_session`: when live compaction is
   applied, surface `compaction_summary_text`, `compaction_turns_summarized`,
   and `compaction_recent_turns_kept` on the session result, taken from the
   `decide_session_compaction` plan dict (`_compaction`).
2. `proxy/router.py` `proxy_to_local`: after `outgoing_headers` is assembled
   (next to the `X-Resolved-Model` header), when compaction was applied add
   the four headers. Build the marker from the proxy's own `_SUMMARY_MARKER` /
   `_SUMMARY_MARKER_END` delimiters so the client never replicates the format,
   and base64-encode it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: When live compaction is applied for a request, the response includes `X-Compaction-Occurred: true` plus `X-Compaction-Marker`, `X-Compaction-Turns-Summarized`, `X-Compaction-Recent-Turns-Kept`.
- AC2: The marker header content decodes to the exact message content the proxy injected into the compacted history, verbatim, including delimiters.
- AC3: Non-compaction responses (noop / below-trigger / dry-run / remote_with_guidance) set none of these headers.
- AC4: Header emission is fail-safe: any error surfaces no compaction headers and never changes dispatch behaviour (additive only, after compaction is applied).
- AC5: Headers survive streaming responses (SSE) — set on the outgoing `StreamingResponse`, not inside the streamed body.
- AC6: `_handle_session` surfaces `compaction_summary_text`, `compaction_turns_summarized`, and `compaction_recent_turns_kept` when and only when live compaction is applied.
- AC7: All tests in `proxy/tests/test_compaction_headers_contract.py` pass, and the full suite passes.

## Notes

- Reuses existing `plan_session_compaction` fields (`summary_text`, `turns_summarized`, `recent_turns_kept`); no compaction logic changes.
- Test-first: depends on the contract-tests child.
- Header size caveat: summaries are base64'd into one header; if real summaries exceed a few KB, revisit with a sidecar endpoint.

**Key Files:**
- `proxy/proxy/router_helpers.py`
- `proxy/proxy/router.py`
- `proxy/proxy/compaction.py`
- `proxy/tests/test_compaction_headers_contract.py`

data.comment: Implementation approach: _handle_session surfaces compaction_summary_text/compaction_turns_summarized/compaction_recent_turns_kept only on the live-applied path (child AC6); proxy_to_local emits the four X-Compaction-* headers via a new fail-safe _build_compaction_headers() helper on both the streaming and buffered paths. The contract tests landed red in child LP-0MU44KR5F0015D7A as xfail(strict=True); this commit removes the markers so they pass for real. Also added two _handle_session metadata unit tests to test_router_helpers_compaction.py and documented the header contract in docs/session-compaction-design.md 7.3.
